description: 后翼弃兵交换变 D35 — 稳健局面的易位时机

intro.popup:
练习第7局
后翼弃兵——交换变
稳健局面里的易位时机
黑方第5步就O-O
白方等到第23步才O-O
注意观察：什么时候是最合适的易位时机？
intro.popup_en:
Practice Game 7
Queen's Gambit Exchange Variation
When should you castle in a quiet position? Black castles on move 5, while White waits until move 23. Watch how the best timing depends on the position and the pieces' readiness.

outro.popup:
稳健局面的易位判断
① 封闭局面中易位时机更灵活
② 黑方早早O-O提高王的安全
③ 白方完成子力调配后再O-O
④ O-O之前：Bd3象主动，c5打压
节奏：不急不慢，等子力准备好！
outro.popup_en: Castling in a quiet position: a closed center allows more flexibility. Black castles early for king safety; White first coordinates the pieces, places the bishop actively on d3, and responds to ...c5 before castling. The lesson is to find a steady rhythm and castle when the position is ready.

moves.popup_en: d4 opens with a central pawn.
...Nf6 develops a knight toward the center.
c4 offers the Queen's Gambit pawn and challenges the center.
...e6 supports the center and opens a diagonal for the bishop.
Nf3 develops and supports the center.
...d5 claims central space.
Nc3 develops and supports d5 pressure.
...Be7 develops and prepares kingside castling.
Bg5 pins the knight and increases pressure on the center.

moves.popup:
O-O！黑方早早易位
第5步就完成易位
稳健开局中及时易位是标准做法
moves.popup_en: ...O-O! Black castles early, on move 5, securing the king in a quiet opening. Timely castling is a standard plan here.
e3 reinforces White's center.
...h6 challenges the bishop.
Bh4 steps away from the pawn attack while maintaining the pin.
...b6 prepares to develop the bishop to b7.

moves.popup:
cxd5交换变！
这就是交换变体
moves.popup_en: cxd5 starts the Exchange Variation by exchanging central pawns.
...Nxd5 recaptures with the knight.
Bxe7 exchanges White's bishop for Black's bishop.
...Qxe7 recaptures with the queen.
Nxd5 exchanges the knight on d5.
...exd5 recaptures and restores a pawn in the center.

moves.popup:
Bd3！白象主动进驻
朝向h7，将来可能进攻
白方还没有易位，在等待最佳时机
moves.popup_en: Bd3! White places the bishop actively, aiming toward h7 and keeping future attacking options. White delays castling while waiting for the right moment.
...c5 challenges White's center and changes the position.

moves.popup:
O-O！白方终于易位！
等到第12步（双方第23步）才易位
此时Bd3已经主动，c5结构已出现
这就是稳健局面——等待最合适的时机！
moves.popup_en: O-O! White finally castles on move 12 (the 23rd ply). The bishop is already active on d3 and Black has committed to ...c5. In this quiet position, White waited until the timing was right.
